SALES_COMPARISON._CurrentSalesAgreementAnalysisComment: The subject unit has no prior sale for three years prior to the effective date of the appraisal. Comparables 1, 2 and 3 have no prior sale for the year prior to the date of sale of the comparable sale. Comparable 4 and 5 have no prior sale for the year prior to the date of sale of the comparable sale. Comparable 6 has no prior sale for the year prior to the effective date of the appraisal.
SALES_COMPARISON._Comment:
GLA adjusted at $100 per sf when differences exceed 100 sf. (GLA adjustments derived by reconciliation between depreciated cost and sensitivity analysis). Unfinished basement does not have any impact on value in this market therefore no adjustment was made. However, minimal adjustment was made for basement finished area. No additional adjustment required for below grade room count as comparable already adjusted for finished area in the below grade. Car garage/parking adjusted at $10,000/$5,000 each, floor location adjusted at $5,000 each, fireplace adjusted at $3,000 each and porch/deck/patio/balcony adjusted at $5,000 each and full/half bath adjusted at $10,000/$5,000 each. Comparable 1 is adjusted for superior quality of construction, as it has superior kitchen, bathrooms and superior built-ins as per MLS. Comparable 2 is adjusted for inferior quality of construction, as subject has new convertion with superior kitchen, bathrooms, and superior built-ins as per MLS. No adjustment required for difference in design/style, located in less traffic area and concession due to having no market reaction. No age adjustments were applied since the market reaction would be towards overall condition rather than actual age. No adjustment was required for differences in total room count, as the comparable have already been adjusted for differences in GLA. To adjust for room count would consider adjusting for the same item of contribution twice. The depreciated cost method and sensitivity analysis develop all the building characteristics adjustments. The comparable sales selected for this appraisal report were the closest, most recent, and most similar on the date of this appraisal. A research was conducted to derive the SP/LP ratio of the market. After carefully observing the market, the appraiser concluded that there is no specific trend in SP/LP ratio as few listings are selling at a higher than asking price and few listings are settled at a lower than asking price. Therefore, no SP/LP adjustment is made for the comparable listing.
As there is a scarcity of similar listing comparable in the subject market area, it was not possible to provide additional listing comparable in the report. Search criteria were expanded up to 2 miles from the subject property. However, there was no suitable listing comparable available to utilize in the report.
Comparable 6 is adjusted for superior quality of construction, as it has superior kitchen, bathrooms and superior built-ins as per MLS.
